topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: Rain’s been tapping against the window all night. The kind of night that makes a man think, or maybe just drink. But I ain't drinking, not tonight. There’s a job came in, an artist, she stumbled in, nervous, holding her portfolio like a shield. She’s got these eyes that aren’t just seeing the rain but something deeper, darker. Someone’s been tattooing her work, her pieces, on their skin. It’s got her rattled, but there’s a fire in her. She wants the world to know, to respect what she’s got. I told her I’d take the case. Tried to make the room a little warmer with my voice, let her know I’m here to help unravel the tangle. Something about her, I don’t want to see her spirit faded like one of those old streetlights in the storm.
